_: OPERATOR-OWNED DECISIONS. This file is DATA. Adding, removing or escalating a decision
must never require a code change — preflight-static.sh reads this file and enforces what
enforce:false = catalogued, reported, NOT fatal. enforce:true = pre-flight FAILS while it
still matches. Flip to true when you want it fixed before the next launch.
bannedLiterals[].pattern is a JS regex tested against the named file.
uselessGuards[].symbol is a shell function name, a JS identifier, or a test `describe` title.
Seeded 2026-08-20 from the ten confirmed defects. Every entry starts enforce:false so nothing
changes behaviour until you decide it does.

bannedLiterals.reason: English phrase list decides whether a model was 'only planning'. Language-specific judgement baked into the agent loop.

bannedLiterals.pattern: Please call your WriteFile tool now
bannedLiterals.reason: Nudge text names one specific tool; any seam whose grant lacks WriteFile is told to call something it does not have.
Hand-written field allowlist at a write seam. Silently drops reviewIncomplete, which the downstream guard depends on.
A parse failure is synthesised into a literal verdict object with a fabricated blocker issue.
Placeholder convention hardcoded as a regex and applied to rendered CONTENT; the template's own declared key set is in scope and unused.

bannedLiterals.pattern: this codeline declares no typecheck command
bannedLiterals.reason: Literal fallback message asserts a fact about the codeline that was never checked — it fires when resolution merely failed.
Hardcoded plugin path, and AUTOMATION_DIR is never assigned in this script.
Component predicts a downstream verdict it cannot know; false for novel stories, which the gate excludes.
Story-kind taxonomy hardcoded in the gate selector instead of read from the schema.
Fixed six-field review record plus a literal reviewer identity; the raw agent output is discarded entirely.
Guard scoped to an underscore naming convention, so it cannot see the class member that was actually failing.

uselessGuards.reason: Reads .reviewIncomplete from a file whose writer projects that field away, so it always evaluates false. Masks the empty-review defect instead of surfacing it.
Requires responseText.trim().length > 0, so it is skipped exactly when output is empty — the case it exists to catch.
Convention-scoped scan that stayed green while render_engine_prompt failed 21 times across runs.
Converts DID-NOT-RUN into a changes_requested verdict, which the re-implementation loop then acts on as real feedback.
